newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia C. bank foreign assets up 8 pct in December.
newsitem.headline: Latvia C. bank foreign assets up 8 pct in December.

text.p: Latvia's central bank said on Monday that its foreign assets in convertible foreign currencies rose 7.9 percent to 358.5 million lats in December last year from 332.2 million lats the previous month.
The bank also said in its regular monthly bulletin that currency in circulation rose in December to 282.6 million lats from 262.8 million lats in November.

The central bank said that a return of confidence in the banking sector continued with demand deposits in commercial banks rising to 300.5 million lats in December from 271.7 million lats in November.
Time deposits in December dipped slightly to 63.8 million lats from 66.7 million lats.

Short-term credits granted by commercial banks rose to 117.3 million lats in December from 98.7 million lats in November while long-term credits granted fell to 94.2 million lats from 101.2 million lats.
The central bank also said that the average interbank market rate for credits in lats was 9.7 percent in December after 7.9 percent in November.
